## Contents

- [Use](#use)

## Use

Read [shared theme guidance](../GUIDANCE.md) before using this reference.
Use this file with one selected slug from [CATALOG.md](../CATALOG.md).

## Style foundations

- Visual style: modern, editorial
- Typography scale: 14/16/18/24/32/40 | Fonts: primary=Gelasio, display=Gelasio,
  mono=Ubuntu Mono | weights=100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800, 900
- Color palette: primary, secondary, neutral, success | Tokens: primary=#111111,
  secondary=#f1f1f1, success=#16A34A, warning=#D97706, danger=#DC2626,
  surface=#FFFFFF, text=#111827
- Spacing scale: 8pt baseline grid

## Copy tone

- Tone: concise, confident, helpful, clear, friendly, professional,
  action-oriented, low-jargon.

## Design intent

Magazine-inspired editorial layout with refined serif typography, structured
grids, and elegant reading experiences.
